headline: Anthropic Files for US Initial Public Offering with 92-Page Risk Disclosure
summary: AI creator Anthropic filed to go public on the US stock market, publishing a 92-page risk factor document acknowledging potential societal and business dangers.
why: Anthropic is a major artificial intelligence developer; its public market debut serves as a significant bellwether for investor appetite in generative AI firms and technology valuations.

impacts.name: Anthropic
impacts.why: An initial public offering filing initiates the process of listing shares on public equity markets.
